mainTopic: How ביטול works when impure תרומה falls into pure חולין: the מחלוקת of רבי אליעזר and חכמים, and a ברייתא introduced about the status of those חולין
overview: This amud opens in the middle of a משנה from מסכת תרומות that the גמרא is quoting. The case is a סאה of impure תרומה that fell into one hundred סאה of pure חולין. רבי אליעזר says one סאה must be lifted out and left to rot. His reason is that we view the removed סאה as the same impure סאה that fell in. חכמים say the תרומה is nullified in the larger amount, so nothing has to be thrown away. Even so, they require the mixture to be eaten in ways that keep the impure תרומה inside it from spreading טומאה: dry, roasted, kneaded with fruit juice, or split into batches with less than a כביצה each. The amud ends as the גמרא begins quoting a ברייתא about 'those חולין'. That quote continues on the next amud.

steps.title: רבי אליעזר: remove one סאה and let it rot
steps.stepSummary: In the case of impure תרומה that fell into 100 סאה of pure חולין, רבי אליעזר rules that one סאה is lifted out and left to rot. His reason is that the סאה taken out is viewed as the very סאה that fell in.
steps.simpleTranslation: …into one hundred סאה of pure חולין: רבי אליעזר says, one סאה is lifted out and left to rot, because I say that the סאה that fell in is the סאה that came out.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is in the middle of quoting a משנה about impure תרומה that fell into pure חולין, and here we hear רבי אליעזר's ruling.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Normally, when one סאה of תרומה falls into 100 סאה of חולין, one סאה is removed and given to a כהן to eat. Here the fallen תרומה was impure, and impure תרומה may not be eaten. So רבי אליעזר says the removed סאה must be left to rot. His logic is that we treat the removed סאה as if it were the actual impure סאה that fell in.

keyTerms.meaning: Impure תרומה, which a כהן may not eat and which must be destroyed
It is lifted out and left to rot

keyTerms.term: הִיא סְאָה שֶׁנָּפְלָה הִיא סְאָה שֶׁעָלְתָה
keyTerms.meaning: The סאה that fell in is the same סאה that came out

steps.confusionAlert: The beginning of the case, 'סאה of impure תרומה that fell', appeared on the previous amud. The words 'into one hundred pure חולין' finish that sentence. They are not a new case.

phrases.english: into one hundred [se'a of] pure non-sacred produce,
phrases.notes: Completes the case begun on the previous amud: a סאה of impure תרומה fell in.

phrases.english: Rabbi Eliezer says: let it be lifted out and rot,
phrases.notes: One סאה is removed and destroyed, since impure תרומה cannot be eaten.

phrases.english: is the se'a that came out.
phrases.notes: We view the removed portion as the actual impure תרומה.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues a משנה that the גמרא began quoting earlier.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to רבי אליעזר, one סאה is removed and left to rot, because the removed סאה is viewed as the impure סאה that fell in.

steps.title: חכמים: it is nullified, but must be eaten in ways that avoid spreading impurity
steps.stepSummary: חכמים rule that the impure תרומה is nullified in the 100 סאה. However, the mixture must be eaten dry or roasted, or kneaded with fruit juice, or divided into batches so that no single batch contains a כביצה of the תרומה.
steps.simpleTranslation: חכמים say: the תרומה is nullified. The mixture is eaten as dry crumbs or roasted, or kneaded with fruit juice, or divided into separate doughs, as long as no single place has a כביצה.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה gives the opinion of חכמים, who disagree with רבי אליעזר. They say the תרומה is simply nullified, but they add rules for how to eat the mixture.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For חכמים, the impure תרומה becomes part of the mixture, and nothing has to be thrown away. Still, its טומאה is physically present, so they want to stop it from spreading. Each option prevents that: dry food and fruit juice do not make food able to receive טומאה (הכשר), and food smaller than a כביצה does not pass on טומאה.

keyTerms.meaning: It is nullified, literally 'it rises' (absorbed into the majority)
Dry crumbs; eaten dry without water
Fruit juice, which does not make food susceptible to טומאה
An egg-bulk, the minimum amount of food that can transmit טומאה

steps.whyThisMatters: It shows that ביטול can settle the status of a mixture while practical concerns about the physical טומאה still remain. This distinction can matter for the surrounding sugya on ביטול and טומאה.
steps.confusionAlert: חכמים are not saying the mixture is impure. It is nullified and permitted. The rules about how to eat it only stop the טומאה of the absorbed תרומה from spreading.

phrases.english: And the Rabbis say: it is nullified,
phrases.notes: Absorbed into the 100 סאה; nothing must be removed.

phrases.english: and it is eaten as dry crumbs or roasted,
phrases.notes: Kept dry so that it is not made susceptible to impurity.

phrases.english: or it is kneaded with fruit juice,
phrases.notes: Fruit juice does not make food susceptible to impurity.

phrases.english: or it is divided into separate doughs,
an egg-bulk in any one place.
phrases.notes: Less than a כביצה of the תרומה per batch cannot transmit טומאה.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the opposing view to רבי אליעזר within the same quoted משנה.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to חכמים, the impure תרומה is nullified, but the mixture must be eaten in a way that keeps its טומאה from spreading: dry, roasted, kneaded with fruit juice, or in batches each under a כביצה.

steps.title: Introducing a ברייתא about those non-sacred foods
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא begins quoting a ברייתא that comments on this משנה, starting with the words 'those חולין'.
steps.simpleTranslation: And it was taught about it: those חולין…
steps.whatsHappening: This is a setup line. The גמרא is starting to quote a ברייתא that adds to the משנה, and the actual content continues on the next amud.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The phrase ותני עלה means a ברייתא was taught as a comment on this very משנה. 'Those חולין' points back to the 100 סאה of pure חולין in the case. The ברייתא will say something about their status or how they must be treated. That detail is what the גמרא needs for its discussion.

keyTerms.meaning: And a ברייתא was taught about it, a comment on the משנה just quoted
Those non-sacred foods, meaning the 100 סאה in the case

phrases.notes: The ברייתא continues on the next amud.
